unit.why: A short anecdote: R. Michel of Zlotchov predicts that one scholar will never rule correctly, the prediction comes true, and he honours the visiting author of Pri Megadim with a heavenly proclamation about him.
unit.boundary_note: The trailing 'מענין פרנסה' is the heading of the next division.

stories.start_quote: אמר הה״ק מוהר״ר מיכל מזלאטשוב לתלמידו
stories.end_quote: על שלומד בטהרה לשם אל עולם
stories.summary_en: R. Michel of Zlotchov foretells that a certain scholar, who studies Torah only with his lips like Doeg, will never rule correctly, which comes true; when the author of Pri Megadim visits, he honours him and says Heaven proclaimed that halakhah would follow him because he studies in purity.
